<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet">

      <geometry>
        <box size="0.91 0.36 0.95"/>

        <color rgba="0.8 0.7 0.5 1"/>

      <origin xyz="0 0 0.475" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.91 0.36 0.95"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <mass value="30.0"/>
      <!-- Inertia of a solid box: Ixx = 1/12*m*(h^2 + d^2), Iyy = 1/12*m*(w^2 + d^2), Izz = 1/12*m*(w^2 + h^2) -->
      <inertia ixx="1.0" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
               iyy="2.5" iyz="0.0"
               izz="2.6"/>

  </link>

               izz="0.31"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <joint name="left_door_hinge" type="revolute">

    <origin xyz="-0.455 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
